own_solution.law: Ohm's law and Joule heating give P = V^2(1/R1 + 1/R2). Thus P = 12^2(1/6 + 1/12) = 36 W. An aiding series cell changes V to V + q.
assumptions: Wires and the specified sources have negligible resistance.
The branch fuse is initially intact and has the stated negligible resistance.

T1374.regime: The branch current is V/R1 = 2 A, below every listed fuse threshold: 3, 5 and 10 A.

T7F3F.regime: The branch current is 2 A, below every listed fuse rating: 3, 5 and 10 A.

notes: All claims agree with the locked pass-1 review. For either aiding-cell sentence, P(q) = (12 + q)^2/4 W when q is expressed in volts, giving 45.5625, 56.25 and 81 W at 1.5, 3 and 6 V. Both disconnected-cell sentences leave the answer at 36 W. All listed fuse ratings exceed the 2 A branch current, so their certified answers and stated regime hold. The reference expression after the first branch opens is 12^2/12 = 12 W. Every cell variant uses the same shown value and unit; the declared minimal pairs change the cell's attachment as intended. The fuse variants likewise preserve the shown value and unit. No contradictory statements or omitted material dependencies were found.
